subject: OrbitApps — aligning ML/Infra deep-dive slot and attendee roster
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@orbitapps.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@orbitapps.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow from yesterday's discovery — next step?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — super helpful to understand Redwood's runtime and how you handle prefix caching and KV reuse. Priya and I pulled together a short set of notes from our side (attached).

We'd like to lock a technical deep-dive with our ML/Infra folks to validate the integration surface, latency targets, and network requirements (VPC/e2e). Target is a 60–90 minute session. Can your team run that week of Nov 16 or Nov 23? We're US Pacific-based; ideal slots would be late morning our time (11a–1p PT).

High level asks for the session:
- Level-set on model variants you recommend for inference (quantized options)
- Expected p95 token latency at 4x concurrency
- Network flow and any private deployment prerequisites (VPC peering/KMS notes)
- Pre-call checklist for logs/metrics we should prepare

I've attached discovery-notes.pdf and flagged a couple of questions in the doc. If you can propose 2–3 concrete slots and who from your side would attend, we'll confirm and send an invite.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Nguyen
Head of ML Platform, OrbitApps
alex@orbitapps.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (3 pages)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Alex — thanks for the note and the thorough discovery doc. Looping Ben (solutions) and Marissa (CS) so we can coordinate the right attendees from Redwood.

We can run a focused 60–90m technical deep-dive. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Nov 17, 11:00–12:15 (60–75m buffer)
- Wed Nov 18, 11:30–12:30
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00–12:30 (if Nov 23 is a holiday for you, can pick this)

From Redwood side we recommend: Ben to lead the ML/Infra walkthrough and latency benchmarking discussion; Marissa will cover onboarding/ops expectations and success criteria; I will handle integration and rollout policy questions. Please confirm which slot works and list attendees from OrbitApps (title + role).

Pre-call artifacts we'd like from you (short list):
- Annotated sample trace / p95 baseline for your current inference flow
- Any compliance constraints (HIPAA, SOC2 controls) you need enforced in the private deployment
- A list of expected concurrency patterns (per-second RPS and burst behavior)

I'll attach a preliminary agenda and an .ics once you confirm a slot.

Thanks — Soojin

Alex — great, locking Tue Nov 17, 11:00–12:15 PT. I've created the calendar invite (attached .ics) and uploaded a short prep doc to the shared Drive link: it includes a 60-minute agenda plus a 15-minute buffer for follow-ups. Agenda highlights:

1) 11:00–11:10 — Introductions and success criteria (Soojin)
2) 11:10–11:35 — ML/Infra deep-dive: model variants, quantization, expected p95 (Ben)
3) 11:35–11:55 — Network & deployment: VPC/KMS/ingress controls (Ben + Daniel questions)
4) 11:55–12:05 — Ops & onboarding: telemetry requirements and runbook (Marissa)
5) 12:05–12:15 — Open Q&A and next steps / actions

Prep checklist (what we'd like you to upload before EOD Fri Nov 13):
- Sanitized trace (JSON or .har) — tag p95 windows and highlight heavy prefixes
- Short doc with compliance constraints (one page)
- Expected steady-state RPS and peak burst numbers (table is fine)

Ben will drive the technical sections; Marissa will take notes and capture any action items for onboarding. If you want to add a specific tech topic to the agenda (e.g., GPU memory footprints for quantized runs), reply and we'll slot it in.

Thanks for the quick turn — see you on the 17th.

Best,
Soojin
